nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Traffic data from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, including 10-min traffic volumes from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. used to calibrate simulation parameters.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The paper states data is available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.node_name: Vehicle location extraction and matrix formation
nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle coordinates (xi, yi) from video frames to create position matrices mt. Signal states are embedded as constants UG/UR. Matrices from N steps are stacked into state st.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tools named, all key state parameters provided.

nodes_process.node_name: Deep Q-network training with multitask learning
nodes_process.source_quote: A multitask learning strategy is implemented in the training process to improve learning efficiency.
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based Q-network using Adam optimizer. Employs experience replay and a target network for stability. Simultaneously predicts Q-values, mean speed, and queue length using a dual-head FC layer.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all tools and parameters explicitly defined in Table 1 and Algorithm 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator.
nodes_process.description: Simulates the trained DRL model against no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines in a real-world freeway scenario (Qingdao-Huangdao tunnel). Evaluates travel time, speed, and queue length.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, simulation environment and parameters well-defined, tool named.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
nodes_process.description: Divides the control area into 8 subareas and removes information from each subarea individually to test the sensitivity of the DRL controller compared to PI-ALINEA.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, procedure described and subareas mapped in Fig 15, but exact 'removal' method details are brief.
